description: One row per well: which proppant-concentration channel the dashboards should DEFAULT to. Scored on the well's first three substage-refined stage windows (open_well -> close_well) by the nextier-dash conc-channel auto-select algorithm: a channel qualifies when it starts near zero AND passes the stairstep fit_stage gate; ties break auger -> target -> denso -> inline (denso before inline here on purpose, unlike the global CONC_CHANNEL_ORDER). This is a UI default only -- it does not change which channel the labelling algorithms use, and the dropdown stays manually overridable.
sql: SELECT CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS well_name, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS conc_col, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS concentration_feature, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS candidates, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS reason, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS stage_num, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS t0, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS t1, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS channel_notes, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS sample_count, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS algorithm_version, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS source_mode, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS run_id, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS processed_at, CAST(NULL AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS refine_n, CAST(NULL AS TEXT) AS stages_scored FROM datastore:merged_fleet_stream_customer_full_v2 WHERE 1 = 0

well_name.description: Well name. One row per well.

conc_col.description: Physical column chosen (e.g. prop_conc_blend_auger), or NULL when nothing qualified.

concentration_feature.description: The chosen column mapped to the dashboard's slot name: auger | target | denso | inline. NULL when conc_col is NULL. This is the value the dropdown uses.

candidates.description: JSON list of columns that passed BOTH gates, in evaluation order. Empty when the pick came from the starts-at-0 fallback.

reason.description: stairstep_starts_at_0 | stairstep | fallback_present | no_candidate | empty first-stage window. Tiers, best across the scored stages (ties go to the later stage).

stage_num.description: Stage number of the WINNING window among those scored.

channel_notes.description: JSON: per-channel present / starts_at_0 / is_stairstep / reject_reason / n_steps for the winning stage, plus a `by_stage` map of every scored stage.

sample_count.description: Telemetry rows in the scored window.

source_mode.description: Run mode that produced the row.

refine_n.description: How many refined stage windows were scored (up to 3).

stages_scored.description: JSON list of the stage numbers scored.
